segments.say: This is the fastest way to lose a game of chess. Two moves. That's it.
segments.caption: Fastest loss in chess

segments.say: White pushes the f pawn. Weird, but okay. Black plays e5.
segments.caption: Looks harmless...

segments.say: Then White pushes the g pawn too. And now the king has no defenders on that diagonal.
segments.caption: The diagonal is OPEN

segments.say: This is called the Fool's Mate. Rule number one: don't open the diagonal to your king. Tag a friend who would fall for this.
segments.caption: Tag a friend who'd fall for it
